about: titan2 NSE equity-derivatives (F&O) session calendar, read by titan2.clock.SessionCalendar. A date is a trading session when it is a weekday that is not a holiday, unless special_sessions lists it (then its trade flag decides). Dates outside the listed years are never trading days. Holidays are the F&O-segment lists from the NSE circulars named in each year's source, checked against the circular PDFs on nsearchives.nseindia.com on 2026-10-10. Review yearly when NSE publishes the next list (usually mid-December).

regular_hours.note: NSE extended the F&O close to 15:40 from 2026-08-03 (derivatives close = VWAP 15:10-15:40; cash-market closing auction for F&O stocks 15:15-15:35); verified 2026-10-10

2025.source: NSE/FAOP/65588 (2024-12-13) trading holidays 2025; NSE/FAOP/65730 (2024-12-23) Budget live session; NSE/FAOP/70320 (2025-09-22) Muhurat session
